not_run_by_design.mutant: R1-M31 + R1-M32 together: routing guard AND probe depth cap removed
not_run_by_design.why_not_run: With both gone the child neither refuses at the binding check nor stops at the mark, so every nesting level execs one more copy: tests/research/check/main.go:302 exec.CommandContext(self) has no gate other than the mark at :297. The executor measured several hundred live processes from exactly this configuration. Running it again would load this host and add no information, because R1-M31 already shows the probe assertion measures the guard, and R1-M32/R1-M33 show the cap only fires once the guard is gone.
not_run_by_design.substitute_evidence: R1-M31 (guard removed, cap retained) run under a live process sampler; R1-M33 showing the cap branch is never reached in a clean build.
